- [LLET.10.1] **Ordered, no forward references.**
  A `let` can reference earlier `let`s in the
  same rule, pattern bindings from any preceding
  pattern, `const` declarations, and companion
  slots. Cannot reference: later `let`s, later
  patterns, anything in the RHS. Such a reference is an unresolved name
  ([LGRA.22.7]), `DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_BINDING`.
